interaction: Choose walls, trim, door or ceiling in an SVG living room and pick colours from Coastal, Hinterland or Classic Queenslander palettes; each surface repaints with a roller wipe, a note warns when trim and walls are too similar, and schemes can be saved as cards or added to the quote form. The hero paint-chip fan spreads on hover or focus.
notes: Colour names, codes and LRV values are fictional; LRV is estimated from on-screen luminance. Saved schemes stay in this browser only.
